videos.title: Antikythera Missing Gear Mystery
videos.desc: The Antikythera Mechanism is the world’s oldest known computer, yet a crucial gear tooth is still absent. Could it be lost forever? Follow for more ancient tech puzzles.

videos.title: The Vanishing Lake of Sarychev
videos.desc: In 2022, a remote lake in Kamchatka vanished within two days, leaving a barren basin. Explore the evidence and the competing theories that still leave researchers baffled. Follow for more disappearing phenomena.

videos.desc: The Nazca Lines have baffled researchers for centuries. New data suggests they could be ancient guides to underground water sources. Dive deeper into this fresh perspective and more unsolved wonders.

videos.title: Mystery of the Antikythera Gear
videos.desc: A tiny bronze gear vanished from the Antikythera Mechanism, hinting at unknown functions. Stay tuned for more ancient tech mysteries.

videos.title: The Whispering Gallery of St Paul
videos.desc: Inside St Paul's Cathedral lies a dome that lets whispers travel across the space as if by magic. Learn the physics behind the phenomenon and why it still amazes visitors. Follow for more sound mysteries.

videos.title: Riddle 044 Guess20
videos.caption:
A stone golem picks a number from 1 to 1,000,000. Name it and $1,000,000 in diamonds is yours - but you only get 20 yes/no questions. Can you always find it? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 043 Gauss
videos.caption:
Add every number from 1 to 100 before the hourglass runs out and a $2,000,000 treasure chest is yours. No calculator. Can you do it in ten seconds? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 042 Chess204
videos.caption:
Everyone says 64. A cube of cash worth $1,000,000 says you're wrong. How many squares are really on a chessboard? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 041 Ages36
videos.caption:
Three kids, ages multiply to 36, sum on the door - and the butler still can't tell. One hint about cake wins a gold bar worth $700,000. Can you name all three ages? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 040 Boat Kids
videos.caption:
A chest of diamonds worth a million is yours if all four of them reach the far bank. Each soldier weighs 100 kg, each kid weighs 50, the boat holds exactly 100 kg, and nobody can swim. Nine crossings do it. Can you see how? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 039 Pages552
videos.caption:
A $5,000,000 vault opens only if you name the page count of a sealed book. All you know: numbering its pages used exactly 552 digits. Can you solve it before the reveal? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 038 Jugs844
videos.caption:
A $2,000,000 treasure chest is yours if you split 8 liters of water into exactly 4 and 4. You get three clay jugs that hold 8, 5 and 3 liters, no markings at all, and every pour must fill a jug or empty it. Seven pours do it. #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

videos.title: Riddle 037 Miss3
videos.caption:
$500,000 in gold if you get 3 monks and 3 hungry ogres across the river. The boat holds two, and ogres can never outnumber the monks. Can you do it without losing a single monk? #riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #brainheist #quiz
Music: Sneaky Snitch - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0
